Armature AI Labs · Specification reference · Evidence checked 25 October 2026

Compare actuator specifications

Comment or suggest a correction · Basic members can contribute. Feedback becomes public after admin approval.

Chinese and Indian options in one place: published weight, torque, speed, electrical limits, sensing, controls, thermal performance, support and availability.

24 entries: 11 Chinese model/revision entries, 10 NMotion/Kikobot entries, one Mechtex bare-motor option, one unconfigured maxon India route and one Korean ROBOTIS actuator available to order through an Indian retailer. These are not 24 interchangeable complete actuators.

Not established means the reviewed sources do not establish that specification; it does not mean zero or unsupported. Hardware revisions and source conditions remain separate. This view focuses on available specifications; new-actuator development proposals are deferred.

ROBOTIS DYNAMIXEL XM540-W270-RROBOTIS · complete-actuatorDatasheet & revision notes
Brake evidence
Metal gearing; metal front/middle case with engineering-plastic rear. No independent fail-safe holding brake identified.
Power-loss holding / release timing
Not established in reviewed sources
Known torque-off behaviour
Default internal Temperature Limit 80 °C. eManual warns against raising above default; overheat can turn torque off and requires at least 20 minutes cooling. This is protection, not an 80 °C continuous-ambient rating.
IP rating
Not established in reviewed sources
Connector evidence
RS-485 for R variant; 9,600 bps–4.5 Mbps; Protocol 2.0 default and Protocol 1.0 support. T variant TTL does not apply to this SKU.
Drive / controller scope
Published actuator-module mass, including geared motor and internal drive/control electronics. Packaging/accessory inclusion not explicit. Installed mounts, harness, tool and external controller/power must be added separately.

RobStride RS00 baseline

Hardware: Hardware revision not identified; CAN2.0 manual 260713 baseline
Source revision: 384cc561e1ff079c22f68b19908526094430febd / CAN2.0 manual 260713
Pages: PDF pp.8–12 (RS00); pp.9–13 (RS06); catalogue p.38 envelope

  • Primary datasheet / manufacturer source
  • Additional source 1
  • Standalone module mass is not installed joint mass; add cables, mounts, external bearings, brake and any heat sink.
  • No published backlash, stiffness, calibrated torque accuracy, axial/radial/moment load ratings, efficiency map or guaranteed operating life found.
  • One-year warranty in manual is not operating-life evidence.
  • Resistance, inductance and equivalent inertia are from October catalogue, not July manual; verify exact hardware applicability.
  • October 9 Chinese RS00 manual still describes 310 g / 5 Nm / 14 Nm. Catalogue p.38 separately advertises new 330 g / 6 Nm / 17 Nm; separate record provided.
  • October catalogue says 15–60 V; July English manual says 24–60 V. Core baseline follows July.

NH-S2-50

Hardware: Hardware documentation 1.0; downloadable CAD listed as hardware 1.1. Match delivered unit.
Source revision: Live web specification checked 25 Oct 2026; hardware page 1.0; operation/API firmware 0.3.2; CAD list says hardware 1.1.
Pages: Models and Specifications; Drawing; hardware connections; operation Thermal Limit Configuration and Startup Calibration; API setTorqueControl.

  • Primary datasheet / manufacturer source
  • Additional source 1
  • Additional source 2
  • Additional source 3
  • Additional source 4
  • Additional source 5
  • Model label combines manufacturer frame designation and ratio for comparison; confirm final orderable SKU.
  • Speed is labelled peak speed, not no-load speed; no_load_speed_rpm intentionally null.
  • Torque is a running rating at the listed speed; continuous zero-speed holding torque remains unknown.
  • Hardware permits startup motion up to 8°; operation wording alternates motor and actuator movement. Verify actual output movement and gravity support before integration.
  • Control documentation references actuator output calculated from motor encoder and gear ratio. API setTorqueControl describes parameter as motor torque in Nm. Resolve scaling/feedback use experimentally and with supplier.
  • No calibrated physical output torque sensor, torque accuracy, efficiency, backlash or installed mass is established.
  • Board thermal thresholds do not establish a safe housing/touch temperature or hot-ambient endurance.
